name: business logic and money
reason: This is the lens with the most impact and the least operational coverage. D12 holds four race and replay instruments and a test list, which is enough to find the mechanisms but not the rules. Every pricing, refund, coupon, inventory, auction and payout factor is unaddressed: nothing in either repo states how to test a discount stack or a proration cycle.

L08-001.note: Price source authority is a named business logic case in the test list. No artefact performs the check.

L08-004.note: Rounding repetition is a named case with no procedure.

L08-006.note: Quantity overflow is named as an edge case, without a payload or an oracle.

L08-007.note: Discount stacking appears in the list. Ordering rules are not modelled anywhere here.

L08-008.note: Coupon reuse is exactly a race, and the harness enables the test without stating the coupon case.

L08-020.note: Plan downgrade data retention is unaddressed.

L08-023.note: Inventory oversell through a checkout race is the canonical case for both harnesses, and both state the parallel send and the confirmation.

L08-024.note: Single packet attack is the specific technique for racing the final decrement, with a stated oracle.

L08-027.note: Tax jurisdiction and exemption validation are unaddressed.

L08-041.note: A deterministic capture of a multi step flow is the input a transfer abuse test needs. The transfer rules themselves are not modelled.

L08-042.note: Withdrawal versus deposit timing is unaddressed, and it is a race the harness could express.

L08-043.note: Double spend across two channels is a parallel request case, and mitmproxy provides the second channel with byte control.

L08-046.note: Replaying a multi step sequence deterministically and reordering it is the procedure for skipping or reversing an order state, with the resulting state as the oracle.

L08-047.note: Cancel after fulfilment is a race the harness can express and no entry states it as a case.

L08-049.note: Workflow bypass is named in the list. Four eyes enforcement is not.

L08-050.note: Limit circumvention by splitting is a named case with no procedure.
